mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies with a temperature of 69 degrees at Verona City Hall. If you are looking up at the sky later, the International Space Station will be visible tonight at 7:37 PM, appearing in the West Northwest over Cross Plains and moving across to the Northeast near the Home Depot heading toward Madison.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is currently seeking applicants for patrol officer positions, offering opportunities for career growth within a community-oriented department. Additionally, the city continues to review development projects, including site plans at 201 South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival this Friday and Saturday.

In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on September 5, officers discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several main streets, later identifying the event as a viral social media prank.
Culver's is currently closed for a building remodel, so please plan accordingly for your next meal.
